text.p: Malaysian shipbuilder Promet Bhd said on Friday that it was suspending its shares from trading on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE).
In a statement to the KLSE on Friday afternoon, Promet said the suspension was related to talks on a "material transaction" involving the company. It did not elaborate.
Its stock last traded down five cents to 6.85 ringgit.
In a separate statement also issued on Friday, Promet provided details of a land reclamation project in the Philippines.
Promet said the company had submitted a proposal to Philippines authorities to carry out a study of the proposed reclamation project in Laguna Bay, an area south east of Manila.
The project would include the development and maintainance of a highway, raw water treatment and land for the Laguna Bay Reclamation Project in Laguna Bay, the company said.
No further details were given and company officials could not be contacted for further comment.
